description: List all of the library's domains consolidated by hostname across library and folder scopes. Returns { refers: [{ hostname, type, status, scope, library_refer_id, folders, type_inconsistency, created_at }] }. scope is library|folder|mixed; status may be 'mixed' when rows differ; library_refer_id is the library-level row id (null if folder-only); folders is an array of { folder_id, name, refer_id, status }; type_inconsistency=true when the same hostname has divergent ALLOW/BLOCK rows. Referrers with status=deleting are ignored. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_list_refer_all
title: List All Domain Referrers (consolidated)
